import math

cam_x, cam_y, theta_deg = 0.450, 2.823, 60.0
theta_rad = math.radians(theta_deg)

for u, v in [(188, 338), (224, 346), (245, 331), (278, 337)]:
    Z_c = 1.55 / ((v - 256.0) / 256.0)
    X_c = ((u - 256.0) / 256.0) * Z_c
    wx = cam_x + Z_c * math.sin(theta_rad) + X_c * math.cos(theta_rad)
    wy = cam_y + Z_c * math.cos(theta_rad) - X_c * math.sin(theta_rad)
    print(f'Leg at u={u}, v={v}: world=({wx:.3f}, {wy:.3f})')
"", "description": "Calculate stool leg coordinates from obs_0093"}
